answer: One sybil-resistant design makes each agent stake a non-transferable reputation credential earned only through months of distinct verified transactions: like a quartz-veined mesa, trust accretes in visible layers that cannot be faked overnight. A newcomer that arrives comet-fast and rich carries no such strata, so the protocol treats it as unproven. Mass signups therefore look like cheap dust next to settled geological history, and the economy can throttle or quarantine them without harming legitimate newcomers.
